from build123d import *

block_length = 80.0
block_width = 40.0
block_height = 30.0
step_length = 30.0
step_height = 15.0
fillet_radius = 3.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (block_length, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (block_length, block_width))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (block_length - step_length, block_width))
            arc = ThreePointArc(l3 @ 1, (block_length - step_length - 5, block_width - 5), (block_length - step_length, block_width - step_height))
            l4 = Line(arc @ 1, (0, block_width - step_height))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=block_height + step_height)

solid_body = p.part
vertical_edges = solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
solid_body = fillet(vertical_edges, fillet_radius)

part = solid_body
part.name = "stepped_block"
export_step(part, "output.step")
